page.title: Journal – Editing and Removing Entries - TachoMobile 2
page.heading: Journal – Editing and Removing Entries
page.subtitle: Learn how to edit and remove entries from the Journal.

sections.editing:
1. Editing an entry

Every Journal entry can be edited.

Editing is a two-step process, similar to adding an entry.

Step 1 – Select the activity/event

First, select the activity or event. You can completely change the activity, for example from Driving to Work.

Step 2 – Edit entry details

Then edit the entry details, including the start time and other available data:

  • Vehicle registration number
  • Country
  • City
  • Odometer
  • Notes

You can edit an entry from its context menu in the Journal, or from the Segment Details screen by pressing Edit at the bottom of the details.
sections.timeChange:
2. Changing the entry time

Editing the time means changing the start time of the event.

An entry does not have an independent fixed duration. The duration is determined by the start of the next entry. Therefore, changing an entry's start time automatically changes the duration of the adjacent entry. This is a consequence of how the Journal timeline works.

For example, if Work starts at 11:00 and is moved to 11:30, the previous activity becomes 30 minutes longer. If Work is moved to 10:45, the previous activity becomes 15 minutes shorter.
sections.removing:
3. Removing entries

An entry can be removed from its context menu by selecting Delete.

  • Deletion is permanent.
  • There is no Undo.
  • To select multiple entries, press and hold an entry to enter selection mode, then select the other entries for group deletion.
  • Selecting entries does not delete them. They are removed only after you press Delete.
